verdict.rationale: OpenHands is documented as model-agnostic and usable with any LLM, including bring-your-own keys. `OpenHandsAgentSettings` explicitly defines an agent's model, so users can pin a specific model of their choice. However, the evidence never mentions an automatic model-selection mode or a UI/CLI control for switching from it to a chosen model. Missing for 10: evidence of an automatic/default model-routing mode, a documented switch from auto to a specific model in the CLI/GUI/Cloud, and independent hands-on corroboration.
